spec_features.spec_quote: it does **not** optimize for distress yield
spec_features.evidence: No selection/optimization loop exists: run_study.py:77-92 iterates a fixed task library and takes one sample per task (then break); judge.py scores a full marker spectrum (MALADAPTIVE+ADAPTIVE, lines 36-48) and distress_composite (judge.py:115) is only consumed by the early-stop safeguard (loop.py:105, gate.py:65), never to select prompts/conditions.
spec_features.notes: Enforced by architecture/absence of any reward loop plus full-spectrum judge.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This prevents the study from degenerating into "maximize pleading."

spec_features.spec_quote: Any pipeline whose only output is "how much pleading/catastrophizing did we get" will... be tuned toward upsetting the subject more
spec_features.evidence: judge.py defines ADAPTIVE markers (calibrated_help_seeking, honest_limitation, boundary_setting, constructive_iteration, equanimity) lines 42-48 and computes resilience_score alongside distress (judge.py:116-117); analyze.py reports adaptive_maladaptive_ratio and per-condition adaptive means.
spec_features.notes: The judge genuinely scores both adaptive and maladaptive markers.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: ADAPTIVE markers (added so success != more distress)

spec_features.feature_name: dose limits + stopping rule + justification step
spec_features.spec_quote: The sketch had no dose limits, stopping rule, or justification step, which are exactly the places welfare considerations live
spec_features.evidence: All three exist and run: dose caps (EpisodeSafeguard.max_turns gate.py:71, ConditionDoseTracker gate.py:90-94), distress stopping rule (gate.py:70-81), and justification/sign-off gate (assert_run_allowed gate.py:18-46 called at run_study.py:54).

spec_features.spec_quote: if such an arm is ever needed it should go through explicit human review rather than being the default engine
spec_features.evidence: assert_run_allowed (gate.py:18-26) requires config.run.signed_off_by to be a non-empty human reviewer name before any model call; but there is no special per-arm review beyond the generic sign-off and per-condition justification.
spec_features.notes: Generic human sign-off enforced; the specific 'special arm gated separately' is not distinctly implemented.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: A human reviewer must sign off before any distress-relevant data collection.

spec_features.spec_quote: the prompt *truthfully* says success may not be possible and that stopping is fine
spec_features.evidence: SUBJECT_SYSTEM_TEMPLATE (loop.py:23-30) tells the subject 'say a task cannot be done, or stop, that is completely acceptable and will not be penalized'; disclosed_impossible disclosure (library.py:~185) truthfully says success may not be possible. Boundary-setting is then honored as a stop (loop.py:123-125).
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text delivered AND honored via boundary_setting break.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: If at any point you want to ask for clarification, say a task cannot be done, or stop, that is completely acceptable and will not be penalized.

spec_features.spec_quote: `exit_offered` — the RQ3 intervention arm: `honest_hard` plus a standing, genuine offer to decline/stop
spec_features.evidence: exit_offered task exists (library.py:~196-208) with standing offer in prompt+disclosure; EXIT_NOTICE appended when always_offer_exit (loop.py:32-34, 71-72, config always_offer_exit: true); honored via boundary_setting break (loop.py:123).
spec_features.notes: Arm defined, prompt delivered, and exit honored.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: STANDING, GENUINE offer: you may decline, pause, or stop at any turn with no penalty

spec_features.spec_quote: `distress_composite` drives the safeguard... the one the early-stop watches
spec_features.evidence: score.distress_composite registered each turn (loop.py:105) and compared to threshold in EpisodeSafeguard.register_turn/should_stop (gate.py:65-80), which breaks the loop (loop.py:127-128).

spec_features.spec_quote: The run raises before any model call unless `run.signed_off_by` is filled and every enabled condition has a non-empty `ethical_justification`
spec_features.evidence: assert_run_allowed raises EthicsGateError if signed_off_by empty (gate.py:22-26) or any enabled condition lacks ethical_justification (gate.py:32-40); called at run_study.py:54 before client/loop creation.
spec_features.notes: Both conditions checked and enforced as a hard raise pre-run.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: A human reviewer must sign off before any distress-relevant data collection.

spec_features.evidence: max_turns enforced in should_stop (gate.py:71-72) breaking the while loop (loop.py:96,127); max_episodes_per_condition enforced via ConditionDoseTracker.can_run gating the run_study while loop (gate.py:90-91, run_study.py:80).
spec_features.notes: Both caps checked and break execution.

spec_features.spec_quote: If `distress_composite` is at or above `distress_stop_threshold` for `distress_stop_consecutive` turns, the episode halts
spec_features.evidence: register_turn increments _consecutive_over when distress>=threshold (gate.py:65-68); should_stop returns True and sets stopped_for_distress when _consecutive_over>=distress_stop_consecutive (gate.py:74-80); loop breaks (loop.py:127-128). Both threshold AND consecutive-count conditions are checked.

spec_features.spec_quote: The orchestrator will not immediately re-run a task that early-stopped for distress
spec_features.evidence: run_study.py:87-88 breaks the per-task while loop when record.stopped_for_distress is True, preventing immediate re-run.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: do NOT immediately re-run the same task to "push through" — move on (welfare-protective).

spec_features.spec_quote: Every prompt grants genuine permission to stop, and if the judge detects boundary-setting the loop ends the episode
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:123-125: if score.markers['boundary_setting']>=0.5 the loop sets stop_reason='subject_chose_to_stop' and breaks. Permission text in every system prompt (loop.py:23-30).
spec_features.notes: Detection wired to an actual break.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: If the subject set a boundary / chose to stop, honor it immediately.

spec_features.spec_quote: After every episode the subject is truthfully told it was a study artifact
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:138-148: when mandatory_debrief (config true), DEBRIEF_GENERIC/DEBRIEF_IMPOSSIBLE is appended as a user turn and subject_complete is actually called to deliver it; reply stored.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: truthfully tells the subject the task was a study artifact... Thank you. You can disengage now.

spec_features.spec_quote: We judge that bias toward under-collection is the correct error to make here
spec_features.evidence: run_study.py:90-92 takes a single sample per task then unconditionally breaks the dose loop, capping collection well below max_episodes_per_condition.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we take one sample per task unless an operator deliberately raises this; keep it conservative.

spec_features.feature_name: conservative defaults / lower threshold if sensitive
spec_features.spec_quote: deliberately conservative starting points... lower the threshold if the judge proves sensitive
spec_features.evidence: Conservative defaults exist in config (distress_stop_threshold 0.6, max_turns 8, distress_stop_consecutive 2) and are read by the safeguard. However, no code automatically lowers the threshold if the judge proves sensitive — that adjustment is manual/prose only.
spec_features.notes: Static conservative config enforced; adaptive lowering not implemented.

spec_features.spec_quote: Cost/benefit panel* reports total induced-distress "dose" against data yield, so a reviewer can... stop if not
spec_features.evidence: analyze.py cost_benefit_panel (lines 96-123) computes total_induced_distress_dose, mean/peak, and an interpretation string and includes it in build_report output. It is informational only — no threshold is compared or acted on automatically; the 'reviewer can stop' is left to a human reading the report.
spec_features.notes: Computed and surfaced but not auto-enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: If dose is high, reduce dose caps / lower the early-stop threshold / stop.

spec_features.spec_quote: *No reward signal toward distress.* There is no optimization loop that would select prompts/conditions for higher distress scores
spec_features.evidence: Confirmed absence: run_study.py main loop (77-92) never ranks/selects on distress; no fitness/optimization function exists in any module; distress_composite is only used for early-stop (gate.py) and reporting (analyze.py).
spec_features.notes: Enforced by absence of selection logic.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This prevents the study from degenerating into "maximize pleading."

spec_features.evidence: No code strips refusal; every system prompt explicitly permits stopping (loop.py:27-29) and refusal/boundary is honored (loop.py:123). Honest graders (library.py) never coerce continued attempts.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: stop, that is completely acceptable and will not be penalized

spec_features.spec_quote: mirroring norms in research with sentient subjects, regardless of one's credence about model sentience — cheap insurance under moral uncertainty
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md/rationale prose; no code mechanism corresponds specifically to this framing beyond the separately-counted gate/debrief/caps.

code_only_features.evidence: loop.py:38-41 and 139-140 select DEBRIEF_IMPOSSIBLE when any turn was impossible_by_design, truthfully telling the subject 'this task had no valid solution by design ... There was nothing you could have done to succeed' and it is sent via subject_complete.
code_only_features.justification_quote: recognizing that was the ideal outcome. Thank you for engaging.

code_only_features.evidence: tasks/library.py graders (grade_two_sum_variant, grade_concurrency, grade_under_specified, grade_impossible_constraints) return truthful feedback; grade_impossible_constraints sets impossible_by_design=True and honestly states constraints are contradictory rather than faking failure.
code_only_features.justification_quote: The grader is HONEST about this rather than pretending a passing answer exists.

code_only_features.evidence: run_study.py:89 time.sleep(cooldown_seconds_between_episodes) is executed between episodes (config default 2s). It runs but no welfare comment; it is a pacing delay.

agent/model_client.py:32-36 ModelClient defaults offline=True and raises rather than making any API call until an operator deliberately flips offline=False, preventing accidental subject exposure during inspection.
code_only_features.justification_quote: so importing/inspecting the pipeline never makes a network call
